attributes.name: ${var.directory_name}
attributes.description: internal directory for dns forwarding over vpns

attributes.name: aws
attributes.description: private dns zone to enable resolving ec2 private domains

variables.name: vpc_id
variables.description: the id of the aws vpc

variables.name: private_route_table_id
variables.description: private route table id of the aws vpc

variables.name: directory_name
variables.description: the name for the directory

variables.name: directory_password
variables.description: the admin password for the directory

variables.name: dns_subnet_cidr_prefix
variables.description: the cidr prefix for aws dns server subnets

variables.name: vpc_name
variables.description: the name for the vpc

variables.name: cidr_block
variables.description: the cidr block to use for the vpc, required to end with /16

variables.name: subnet_count
variables.description: the number of private subnets to create

variables.name: resource_group_name
variables.description: the resource group to place this vnet in

variables.name: location
variables.description: location to create vnet in

variables.name: network_name
variables.description: the name for the network

variables.name: dns_servers
variables.description: addresses of DNS servers to use for this vnet

variables.name: project_id
variables.description: the project to create the network in

variables.name: regions
variables.description: which regions to create subnets for

variables.name: aws_dns_suffix
variables.description: DNS suffix that AWS uses for internal host names (e.g., ec2.internal, compute.internal)

variables.name: aws_dns_ip_addresses
variables.description: addresses of DNS servers to forward AWS internal DNS requests to

variables.name: aws_region
variables.description: aws region to use

variables.name: aws_directory_service_password
variables.description: password to use for the aws directory service (enabling DNS)

variables.name: google_region
variables.description: the region to connect to in the google network

variables.name: google_project_id
variables.description: the google project id

variables.name: azure_resource_group_name
variables.description: name of the azure resource group to use

variables.name: azure_location
variables.description: name of the azure location to use

variables.name: aws_vpc_id
variables.description: the id of the aws vpc

variables.name: aws_route_table_ids
variables.description: aws route tables to add vpn routes to

variables.name: google_network_name
variables.description: the name of the google network

variables.name: google_subnet_self_links
variables.description: the self links of the subnets of the google network to give access to the vpn

variables.name: google_external_dns_cidr
variables.description: the cidr block associated with google's dns servers

variables.name: azure_network_name
variables.description: name of the azure virtual network to use

variables.name: azure_network_address_space
variables.description: azure cidr blocks to give access to the VPN

variables.name: azure_gateway_cidr
variables.description: cidr block of azure gateway subnet (recommended /27 or larger)

variables.name: azure_gateway_sku
variables.description: product sku of azure vpn gateway

variables.name: dns_network_acl_id
variables.description: network acl id of the dns subnet

outputs.name: vpc_cidr_block
outputs.description: the cidr block of the vpc

outputs.name: private_route_table_id
outputs.description: the private route table of the vpc

outputs.name: public_route_table_id
outputs.description: the public route table of the vpc

outputs.name: network_name
outputs.description: the name of the new network

outputs.name: private_subnet_self_links
outputs.description: the self links of the private subnets of the vpc
